release_notes:
What you can now see and do depends on your role. Your HR admin decides which parts of the app are available to you, so sections you are not permitted to use will not appear at all, and actions you can see but not perform are shown greyed out with a small padlock. Tapping one explains what is missing and who can grant it. Your own attendance, leave, payments and sales information are always available and open exactly as before.

Booking quantities are now entered in bags rather than kilograms. In Booking Post, once you pick a feed product the quantity box is labelled Bag and shows the equivalent weight underneath, so four bags of a twenty five kilo product clearly reads as one hundred kilos before you save. Previously the number you typed was saved as if it were kilograms, which made booked bag counts come back as a fraction of a bag in every report. Chicks bookings are unchanged because those are counted in pieces. Please note that bookings recorded earlier hold the old figure, so records created before this update will read differently from newer ones.
